metadata.title: Anthropic Strikes $9.1 Billion Deal With This Data Center Operator. The Stock Surges.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Riot Stock Soars. What Its $9 Billion Anthropic Cloud Deal Means For the AI Boom.
Riot Platforms stock surged after the Bitcoin miner-turned-data center operator revealed it had signed a $9.1 billion deal with a “leading frontier AI” company.
